principles: One firing implementation: extract a single shared leaf so the dedup-key formula + event payload exist in exactly ONE place (no drift between PLAN and REVIEW sites).
Hand the agent the hints in the text it already reads (REVIEW reviewer-launch guidance) — turn "remember to surface hints" into "the CLI surfaces them".
Advisory-only + measurement-honest: never touch the signed prompt hash; fire on BOTH arms (hintMode distinguishes) once per review round; OFF byte-identical.
Minimal blast radius: no new command (zero registration/contract burden); leaf imports only existing core leaves; behavior-preserving refactor proven by a golden assertion.
drivers: REVIEW lane reviewers are launched by the main agent with hand-written prompts that bypass story_review _reviewPrompt, so the ON arm never influences review and REVIEW rounds emit zero experience_hint_surfaced — learning_effectiveness ON/OFF cannot accrue.

transition-orchestrator persists currentReviewRound before buildNextSteps, so the REVIEW branch can reuse the exact hintRoundKey story_review uses → automatic cross-site dedup + disjoint PLAN/REVIEW namespaces.
A code-verified design workflow chose this hybrid over a new command (registration tax + relies on the agent remembering) and over touching the signed reviewer prompt (invariant risk).

options.name: next-steps-surface-plus-shared-leaf
pros: Hints appear in the text the agent already reads (most forceful without forcing).
Single shared firing leaf = no dedup/payload drift.
Zero command registration burden; advisory-only; OFF byte-identical.
cons: Indirect: the CLI hands hints over but the agent still pastes them into each lane prompt (accepted limitation; dispatch-path deferred).

options.name: new-read-only-review_hints-command
cons: 5-surface + lifecycle-registry-contract tax; the agent must REMEMBER to run it — less forceful than putting hints in the text it already reads.

options.name: inject-into-signed-reviewer-prompt
cons: Risks the resolveReviewPromptHash byte-identical-arms invariant; couples hints to the signed prompt — rejected.

rationale: Surfacing the rendered+A/B-gated hints in buildNextSteps REVIEW reviewer-launch guidance puts them in the exact text the main agent reads to launch lane reviewers, and a single shared leaf (surfaceExperienceHints) makes the firing+dedup+arm logic single-source-of-truth across PLAN and REVIEW. The REVIEW key reuses currentReviewRound (persisted before buildNextSteps) so PLAN (plan:<phase>) and REVIEW (ISO round) are disjoint and never double-count. Zero command-registration burden, signed reviewer prompt hash untouched (byte-identical arms), OFF arm byte-identical to today — the smallest correct change that makes the ON arm reach reviewers and lets learning_effectiveness accrue from REVIEW rounds.

preMortem.scenario: The story-review.ts refactor subtly changes PLAN behavior (drops always-compute-hints or the failure console.warn), altering _reviewPrompt bytes or the event.
preMortem.trigger: Rewriting the firing block instead of moving it verbatim into the leaf.
preMortem.consequence: PLAN-phase A/B behavior silently changes; existing smokes may pass while real output drifts.
preMortem.mitigation: Move the block VERBATIM into the leaf; CHK-001 golden assertion captures _reviewPrompt bytes + event payload before/after and asserts byte-equality on BOTH arms.

preMortem.scenario: A future refactor moves writeStory(currentReviewRound) AFTER buildNextSteps, so the REVIEW key falls back to plan:<phase> and collides with the PLAN event.
preMortem.trigger: Reordering transition-orchestrator without knowing buildNextSteps depends on currentReviewRound being persisted first.
preMortem.consequence: REVIEW events vanish or collide → learning_effectiveness mismeasures.
preMortem.mitigation: Code comment documenting the ordering dependency; CHK-003 smoke asserts the REVIEW event.reviewRound equals the ISO currentReviewRound (not plan:<phase>) and PLAN+REVIEW are disjoint single events.

preMortem.scenario: Hint content leaks into the signed reviewer prompt or a gate, breaking byte-identical arms.
preMortem.trigger: Wiring hints into review-run.ts or feeding renderedSection into resolveReviewPromptHash.
preMortem.consequence: ON vs OFF reviewer-prompt hashes differ → A/B contamination + possible gate dependency on hint content.
preMortem.mitigation: review-run.ts / core/review-run.ts PROTECTED (excluded); hints live only in the buildNextSteps guidance STRING; CHK-003 asserts resolveReviewPromptHash/review-run byte-identical ON vs OFF.

preMortem.scenario: The new hint surfacing throws and blocks/garbles a REVIEW transition.
preMortem.trigger: Not wrapping the buildNextSteps hint block in try/catch, or heavy work on the transition path.
preMortem.consequence: A story cannot enter REVIEW because of an advisory hint surface — unacceptable.
preMortem.mitigation: Wrap the whole block in try/catch (same posture as the existing round-2 advisory); the leaf returns fast on no-signals; CHK-002 asserts the transition still succeeds + active-reviewer set unchanged with hints present.
